mapper.insert: insert into hall(name, location, capacity, seat_layout, create_time) values (#{name}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{seatLayout}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hall set name = #{name}, location = #{location}, capacity = #{capacity}, seat_layout = #{seatLayout} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select * from hall
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and location like concat('%', #{location}, '%')
